summary_en: 417,000 shares (6.01% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired for up to ¥100M between 18 June and 31 August 2026. Rationale: capital structure optimization and return of profits to shareholders following completion of capital reduction to eliminate accumulated losses; dividend of ¥5/share also planned for fiscal year ending August 2026.
title_en: Notice of Decision Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Saikaya Department Store announced on 18 June 2026 a treasury stock acquisition programme authorized by board resolution under Article 165(3) of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 417,000 shares (6.01% of 6.94M shares outstanding ex-treasury) for an aggregate ceiling of ¥100M between 18 June and 31 August 2026, to be executed via ToSTNeT-3. The acquisition is part of broader capital structure optimization and shareholder return initiatives following the company's completion (effective 20 May 2026) of a capital reduction to eliminate accumulated losses of retained earnings. With accumulated-loss elimination achieved, the company is now in position to resume dividends; a ¥5/share dividend is planned for the fiscal year ending August 2026. The stock acquisition, alongside the dividend, represents the company's commitment to capital-efficient return of profits to shareholders.
